name: T12-WF08 - AI CRM Data Cleaning Agent

parameters.content:
## 1. Scan Event & Scope
NestJS creates WorkflowRun and publishes the exact RabbitMQ event.

## 2. Read Batch & Deterministic Rules
Normalize a bounded Lead batch and retain each exact currentValue.

## 3. AI Suggestions & Safety Validation
AI proposes only. It cannot apply updates or decide duplicate survival.

## 4. Callback & Review
Backend stores findings; backend alone revalidates and applies selected findings.

nodes.name: HTTP Request: Load Scan Context
nodes.notes: PROVISIONAL API: existing user-facing scan detail route is JWT-protected. Backend phase must add this workflow-run-scoped N8nAuthGuard route.

nodes.name: Code: Build Duplicate and AI Context

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: $node["Code: Build Duplicate and AI Context"].json.prompt }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0.1, responseMimeType: 'application/json' } } }}

nodes.name: HTTP Request: Gemini Cleaning Suggestions
nodes.notes: GEMINI_API_KEY is read from n8n environment. Do not embed credentials in workflow JSON.

HTTP Request: Cleaning Callback
nodes.notes: Existing NestJS DataCleaningController callback guarded by N8nAuthGuard. Keep X-N8N-API-KEY header.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { workflowRunId: $node['Code: Validate Event'].json.workflowRunId, eventId: $node['Code: Validate Event'].json.eventId, findingCount: $node['Code: Validate Findings and Safety Flags'].json.summary.totalIssuesFound, idempotencyKey: $node['Code: Validate Event'].json.workflowRunId } }}

nodes.notes: PROVISIONAL API CONTRACT: endpoint is not listed in current API contract and must be implemented before activation. It must be idempotent and must not apply Lead changes.
